Mrs. Fisher: Jeez Louise…{{wi}} You look more like shit than regular shit. I think it’s a good time to stop it altogether.
You: But it’s not finished, right? There’s still something lacking.
Mrs. Fisher: Just calm down, kid. You are scaring off the fish…
You: …
I need to go home asap, I’m drenched…
